'''Nagora''' is a Cairhienin [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[White Ajah]] and a loyalist contingent. {{Ref|{{twotc}}, Nagora}}

== Appearance ==
She is lean with pale hair worn in a roll on the nape of her neck. She is short of stature and sits very straight as if to make up for her lack of height.

== History ==
She is one of the few Whites with a [[Warder]].

== Activities ==
She is one of the sisters to hold the shield over [[Leane Sharif]], when [[Egwene al'Vere]] comes to visit her. She also taught Egwene logic; the lesson turned to how to deal with an aging Warder.

She requests a meeting with Egwene and asks what she should do about her Warder who is growing frustrated with his increasing age and inability to fight.
